en.t: Surely your sorrow must be piled up in countless layers."

units.source_text: 写好之后，就交值宿人送进去。

en.t: After he finished writing it, he handed it to the night attendant to take inside.

units.source_text: 这值宿人冻得厉害，肤若鸡皮，拿着诗走了进去。

en.t: The night attendant was terribly chilled, his skin covered with gooseflesh, and he carried the poem inside.

units.source_text: 大女公子心念答诗所用之纸，若非特别薰香，有失体面。

en.t: The elder princess thought that if the paper used for her reply poem had not been specially scented with incense, it would be improper.

units.source_text: 又念此种时机，答诗最贵迅速，就立刻写道：

en.t: She also thought that on such an occasion speed was most valued in a reply poem, so she wrote at once:
